license_required.quote: No person shall act as a real estate broker or real estate salesperson unless licensed as provided in this section.

issuing_authority.quote: "Commissioner" means the commissioner of commerce or a designee.

name.quote: "Commissioner" means the commissioner of commerce or a designee.

type.quote: The commissioner shall issue a license as a real estate broker or real estate salesperson to any person who qualifies for the license under the terms of this chapter.

age_minimum.quote: An applicant for a real estate broker or real estate salesperson license shall be at least 18 years of age at the time of making application for said license.

degree_required.value: 30 hours of instruction approved by the commissioner (broker pre-license course)
degree_required.quote: An applicant for a broker's license must successfully complete a course of study in the real estate field consisting of 30 hours of instruction approved by the commissioner, of which three hours shall consist of training in state and federal fair housing laws, regulations, and rules.

exams.name: Real Estate Broker's Examination
exams.notes: Must score 75% or higher on both the uniform portion and the state portion. Must apply for broker's license within one year of passing the exam.
exams.quote: The examination for a real estate broker's license shall be more exacting than that for a real estate salesperson, and shall require a higher degree of knowledge of the fundamentals of real estate practice and law.

interval_years.quote: A license renewed pursuant to this chapter is valid for a period of 24 months.

required.quote: All real estate salespersons and all real estate brokers shall be required to successfully complete 30 hours of real estate continuing education, either as a student or a lecturer, in courses of study approved by the commissioner, during the initial license period and during each succeeding 24-month license period.

hours_per_period.quote: successfully complete 30 hours of real estate continuing education

period_years.quote: during the initial license period and during each succeeding 24-month license period

value: at least one hour per license period in agency representation and disclosure
at least one hour per license period in state and federal fair housing laws, antidiscrimination laws, or housing needs of immigrant and underserved populations
3.75 or 7.5 hours of module training every license year
at least one hour per license year in a module specifically designed for brokers
topical_requirements.quote: the commissioner shall require that all real estate brokers and salespersons receive: (1) at least one hour of training during each license period in courses in laws or regulations on agency representation and disclosure; and (2) at least one hour of training during each license period in courses in state and federal fair housing laws

available.quote: The requirements of sections 82.59, subdivision 8, and 82.61 may be waived for individuals of other jurisdictions, provided: (1) a written reciprocal licensing agreement is in effect between the commissioner and the licensing officials of that jurisdiction, (2) the individual is licensed in good standing in that jurisdiction, and (3) the licensing requirements of that jurisdiction are substantially similar to the provisions of this chapter.

requirements.value: Written reciprocal licensing agreement must be in effect; applicant must be licensed in good standing in their jurisdiction; licensing requirements of that jurisdiction must be substantially similar to Minnesota's.
requirements.quote: a written reciprocal licensing agreement is in effect between the commissioner and the licensing officials of that jurisdiction, (2) the individual is licensed in good standing in that jurisdiction, and (3) the licensing requirements of that jurisdiction are substantially similar to the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: is permanently or temporarily enjoined by any court of competent jurisdiction from engaging in or continuing any conduct or practice involving any aspect of the real estate business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to reasonably supervise brokers, salespersons, or closing agents causing injury or harm to the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has failed to reasonably supervise brokers, salespersons, or closing agents so as to cause injury or harm to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or failed to comply with any provision of chapter 82 or any rule or order under the chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: In the conduct of licensed affairs, shown to be incompetent, untrustworthy, or financially irresponsible.

definition_quote.value: "Real estate broker" or "broker" means any person who: (a) for another and for commission, fee, or other valuable consideration or with the intention or expectation of receiving the same directly or indirectly lists, sells, exchanges, buys or rents, manages, or offers or attempts to negotiate a sale, option, exchange, purchase or rental of an interest or estate in real estate, or advertises or holds out as engaged in these activities
definition_quote.quote: "Real estate broker" or "broker" means any person who: (a) for another and for commission, fee, or other valuable consideration or with the intention or expectation of receiving the same directly or indirectly lists, sells, exchanges, buys or rents, manages, or offers or attempts to negotiate a sale, option, exchange, purchase or rental of an interest or estate in real estate, or advertises or holds out as engaged in these activities

license_tiers.quote: The commissioner shall have the authority to issue a limited real estate broker's license authorizing the following limited activities: (1) the licensee to engage in transactions as principal only; or (2) the licensee to engage in negotiations of mortgage loans, other than residential mortgage loans

broker_of_record_required.quote: A business entity applying for a license shall have at least one responsible person individually licensed to act as broker for the brokerage.

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: Every application for a broker's examination shall be accompanied by proof that the applicant has had a minimum of three years of actual experience within the previous five-year period prior to application as a licensed real estate salesperson

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: An applicant for a broker's license must successfully complete a course of study in the real estate field consisting of 30 hours of instruction approved by the commissioner

required_instruction_topics.quote: The required course for real estate brokers must consist of the subject hours in paragraphs (a) to (j).

exam_application_window_years.quote: After successful completion of the real estate broker's examination, an individual shall have one year from the date of the examination to apply for a broker's license

inactive_license_max_years.quote: any licensee having been licensed as a broker or salesperson in the state of Minnesota and who shall fail to renew the license for a period of two years shall be required by the commissioner to again take an examination

license_revocation_reapplication_waiting.quote: No applicant shall be eligible to take any examination if a license as a real estate broker or salesperson has been revoked in this or any other state within two years of the date of the application.

agency_relationship_types.quote: The available options are listed below... I. Seller's Broker... II. Buyer's Broker... III. Dual Agency... IV. Facilitator

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: Broker cannot act as a dual agent unless both the seller(s) and the buyer(s) agree to it.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: A broker or salesperson who performs services for a Buyer, a Seller, or both but does not represent either in a fiduciary capacity as a Buyer's Broker, Seller's Broker, or Dual Agent.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: A real estate broker or salesperson shall provide to a consumer in the sale and purchase of a residential real property transaction at the first substantive contact with the consumer an agency disclosure form

written_service_agreement_required.quote: Licensees shall obtain a signed listing agreement or other signed written authorization from the owner of real property or from another person authorized to offer the property for sale or lease before advertising to the general public that the real property is available for sale or lease.

sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: All listing agreements must be in writing and must include: (1) a definite expiration date; (2) a description of the real property involved; (3) the list price and any terms required by the seller; (4) the amount of any compensation or commission or the basis for computing the commission

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: All listing agreements must be in writing and must include: (1) a definite expiration date

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: A licensed real estate broker shall retain for six years copies of all listings, buyer representation and facilitator services contracts, deposit receipts, purchase money contracts, canceled checks, trust account records, and such other documents as may reasonably be related to carrying on a real estate brokerage business.

escrow_account_required.quote: All trust funds received by a broker or the broker's salespeople or closing agents shall be deposited, as provided in subdivision 5, in a trust account, maintained by the broker for such purpose

escrow_deposit_deadline_business_days.quote: If the written agreement between the parties is silent as to the timing of the deposit of earnest money, the listing broker shall deposit the earnest money within three business days of either receipt of the earnest money or final acceptance of the purchase agreement, whichever is later.

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: A broker, salesperson, or closing agent shall deposit only trust funds in a trust account and shall not commingle personal funds or other funds in a trust account

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: If a brokerage maintains more than one place of business, each place of business shall be under the direction and supervision of an individual broker licensed to act on behalf of the brokerage.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: A salesperson must be licensed to act on behalf of a licensed broker and may not be licensed to act on behalf of more than one broker in this state during the same period of time.

qualified_association_permitted.quote: A licensed real estate broker or salesperson may assign or direct that commissions or other compensation earned in connection with a real estate or business opportunity transaction be paid to a corporation, limited liability company, or sole proprietorship of which the licensed real estate broker or salesperson is the sole owner.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: There is hereby created in the state treasury a real estate education, research and recovery fund which shall be administered by the commissioner

recovery_fund_max_per_claim.quote: up to the sum of $150,000 of the amount unpaid upon the judgment, provided that nothing in this chapter shall be construed to obligate the fund for more than $150,000 per claimant, per transaction

recovery_fund_max_per_licensee.quote: regardless of the number of claims against a licensee, nothing in this chapter may obligate the fund for more than $250,000 per licensee

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: A person licensed under this chapter or chapter 82B may prepare and provide a broker price opinion and a broker may charge and collect a fee for it if the license of that licensee is active and in good standing.
